mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as earnings growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% in one month indicate broad consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as near-term earnings growth expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL > 245) prompts delayed monetary easing, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as real rates rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 245, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increase (UNRATE > 5.0%) and employment decline (PAYEMS < 144 million) signal labor market contraction, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS declines > 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market expansion (HOUST > 1150) boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days during housing booms.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1150, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over 3-year windows.
